What products can I purchase using the purchase order form?

You can purchase digital licenses for Life Skills Advocate’s Real-Life Executive Functioning Workbook.

What is the difference between a single license and multiple licenses?

Single License: A single license is appropriate when an individual professional (e.g., a teacher, therapist, or counselor) purchases the workbook for their own use with multiple students or clients. The licensed professional may share individual exercises or worksheets with their students digitally (e.g., via Google Classroom or printed copies), but they may not share the full workbook with students.

Multiple Licenses: Multiple licenses are required when multiple professionals within an organization (e.g., a school district or clinic) need access to the workbook. Each professional may share individual exercises or worksheets with their students but may not distribute the full workbook to students unless the organization purchases a full copy for each student. Organizations may purchase full copies for each student if they wish to provide full access to the workbook for individual use.

Can I share the workbook with students or families?

You can share individual exercises with your students or clients, but you cannot share the full workbook unless a full copy has been purchased for each individual. Families or clients interested in a personal copy must purchase one directly from us here.

When submitting a purchase order, what documents do I need to upload with my order?

Make sure to upload the following:

  • School District or Organization Purchase Order
  • Signed Bulk Purchase Agreement (applicable for bulk purchases only)
  • Signed Terms & Conditions (applicable for bulk purchases only)

What if I need to make changes to my purchase order after submitting?

You can make changes to your submission by clicking the "Edit" button at the end of the Google Form.

If you need further assistance, feel free to contact us at admin@lifeskillsadvocate.com, and we’ll be happy to help with any updates or corrections.

What are the pricing tiers for bulk purchases?

The pricing for bulk licenses is as follows:

  • 1–4 licenses: $79 each
  • 5–20 licenses (10% off): $71.10 each
  • 21–40 licenses (15% off): $67.15 each
  • 41–50 licenses (20% off): $63.20 each
  • 51–100 licenses (25% off): $59.25 each
  • 101–500 licenses (40% off): $47.40 each
  • Custom quotes available for unlimited licenses (reach out to admin@lifeskillsadvocate.com to inquire)

Will you honor coupon codes for purchase orders?

Yes, we will honor coupon codes for purchase orders, but only for single license orders. If you are purchasing multiple licenses, coupon codes cannot be applied.

If using a coupon code, please make not of it on the purchase order document.

Can I qualify for bulk discount pricing even if I don't want to submit a purchase order?

Yes, please reach out to admin@lifeskillsadvocate.com and we'll be happy to help.

Can I purchase full copies for each student?

Yes, if your organization would like to provide a full copy of the workbook to each student, you can purchase individual copies for them.

What happens after I submit my purchase order?

You will receive a confirmation email, and our team will respond within 72 business hours to process your order. Once confirmed and if there are no outstanding questions, we will generate an invoice and distribute the materials immediately.

Communication will come from admin@lifeskillsadvocate.com or chris@lifeskillsadvocate.com. If you believe your organization’s firewall may block our emails, please whitelist these addresses.

How does the distribution of materials work?

Typically, school districts or organizations handle the distribution of the workbooks to their professionals internally. However, if preferred, you can provide a list of professionals, and we will distribute the workbooks directly to them.

What is the refund policy?

We offer a 7-day satisfaction guarantee for bulk purchases. If you're not satisfied, you can request a refund within 7 days of purchase. No refunds are issued after this period.

Can I use the workbook for online learning?

Yes, specific exercises from the workbook can be used in online platforms such as Google Classroom or Canvas. However, the full workbook cannot be shared digitally with students or clients.

I need your W-9 to add you as a vendor in our system before submitting a purchase order. Where can I find that?

Our W-9 may be accessed here.

How do I contact you if I need assistance?

If you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to reach out to us at admin@lifeskillsadvocate.com.
